title: clearRefinements does not clear configure disjunctiveFacetsRefinements: {   categories: ['Cell Phones']
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

clearRefinements does not clear configure disjunctiveFacetsRefinements: {   categories: ['Cell Phones']}   

even tho when I inspect the call using 
  transformItems(items) {
                console.log("clear items:",items)
                return items;
categories is in items.   Actually it looks like clearing is interrupted or it's not fully cleared or re-added? definitely not re-added by me because when I'm adding disjunctiveFacetsRefinements I console log it.  Other possibility is that it's added multiple times while clearing does not clear  all instances?


## 🔍 Bug reproduction

press clearRefinements  button after adding disjunctiveFacetsRefinements 


**Live reproduction:**



## 💭 Expected behavior

clearRefinements should clear all refinements?

## 🖥 Screenshots


## Environment

- Version: . 4.39.1

## Additional context

comments.body: This behaviour indeed sounds like a bug. Do you have a reproduction? We have a template available for that purpose [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js). Thanks!

I've made a workaround by storing a pointer to the configure widget and then remove it manually with removeWidget.  
I've also noticed another related bug:   transformItems from clearRefinements is called multiple times when searching.  Which makes no sense, as the clearRefinment related routines should only be triggered when initiated by the user?

@dianos did you make a reproducible example of this? Is it related to something in your app or does it always happen? You can base your reproduction on https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js

In theory you could implement a non-pure transformItems, so we can't know if it should be called again on every render, or only when something has changed
As there was no reproduction, I'll close this issue now. Refinement via the parameters is meant to be done via initialUiState or setUiState, not via configure
